SAP Concur

Manage expense reports, travel requests, cash advances, and more in SAP Concur

Instructions d'utilisation

Connect SAP Concur via OAuth 2.0. Manage expense reports and line items, allocations, attendees, comments, exceptions, quick expenses, receipts, travel requests and expected expenses, cash advances, itineraries, user identities, custom lists, budgets, exchange rates, and purchase requests across every Concur datacenter.

Outils

sap_concur_approve_expense_report

Approve an expense report as a manager (PATCH /expensereports/v4/reports/{reportId}/approve). Required body field: comment.

Entrée

ParamètreTypeObligatoireDescription
datacenterstringNonConcur datacenter base URL (defaults to us.api.concursolutions.com)
grantTypestringNonOAuth grant type: client_credentials (default) or password
clientIdstringOuiConcur OAuth client ID
clientSecretstringOuiConcur OAuth client secret
usernamestringNonUsername (only for password grant)
passwordstringNonPassword (only for password grant)
companyUuidstringNonCompany UUID for multi-company access tokens
reportIdstringOuiExpense report ID to approve
bodyjsonOuiRequest body â€” comment is required by Concur (e.g., { "comment": "Approved" }). If the report contains rejected expenses, expenseRejectedComment is also required. Optional fields: expectedStepCode, expectedStepSequence, statusId (defaults to "A_APPR").

Sortie

ParamètreTypeDescription
statusnumberHTTP status code returned by Concur
datajsonEmpty (204 No Content)
